meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会系统地把仓库里每个源文件从头到尾读一遍,大文件会分页读完,从而形成对代码库的整体理解。
howto.when: 当你说出“学习代码库”“阅读代码库”“预热”等要求,或刚开始接触新/陌生项目时触发。

say.note: Claude 会开始逐个读完源文件。

say.text: 通读全部源码,然后总结项目结构。
say.note: 它会通读后给出整体认识。

say.text: 这个项目我刚接手,帮我快速熟悉代码。
say.note: 触发逐文件阅读并建立理解。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will systematically read every source file in full, paging through large files with the Read tool, to build a deep understanding of the codebase.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", etc., or when starting on a new or unfamiliar project.

say_en.text: Please learn the entire codebase first.
say_en.note: Claude will start reading source files one by one.

say_en.text: Read all source code and summarize the project structure.
say_en.note: It will read through and give an overall picture.

say_en.text: I just took over this project; help me get up to speed.
say_en.note: Triggers full file-by-file reading and understanding.
